parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The configuration ID. You can call the [ListUrlObservations](~~ListUrlObservations~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID.

parameters.name: SdkType
parameters.description:
The SDK integration method. Valid values:

- **automatic**: automatic integration.
- **manual**: manual integration.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
